**STR** 3 (-4) | **DEX** 13 (+1) | **CON** 8 (-1) | **INT** 2 (-4) | **WIS** 12 (+1) | **CHA** 7 (-2)
**Skills:** [Skill: Perception](../proficiencies/skill-perception.md) +5, [Skill: Stealth](../proficiencies/skill-stealth.md) +5
